name: batch-01
prompt:
Create ONE production game-icon SPRITE ATLAS, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows on a square canvas, ideally 2048x2048, genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha PNG. Input image is the user's approved style sheet, STYLE reference only. Match that soft tactile dimensional 3D collectible family: gentle warm upper-left diffuse studio light, rounded yet faithful forms, bright pastel/candy color, subtle ambient occlusion, restrained material detail. Each object's true material remains recognizable: paper, wood, glass, metal, woven cloth. No same-clay treatment on everything. No heavy dark outlines or flat vector art.

CRITICAL PACKAGING: There are EXACTLY NINE equal square virtual cells in a regular 3x3 grid. Draw ONE specified object/group centered within EACH virtual cell, at about 72% cell width/height with at least 12% empty transparent margin on every side. Nothing may touch a virtual cell edge or cross into a neighbor. All strings, handles, leaves and shadows stay inside their own cell. No visible grid lines, no backgrounds, no color squares, no borders, no captions, numbers, words, ID labels, titles or decorative props. Empty padding is genuine alpha transparency, NOT a drawn checkerboard. Top-left through bottom-right order is mandatory; do not swap cells. Each tile will be cropped at exact one-third boundaries into a separate icon. Keep centered and similarly weighted, readable at 32–66px. All objects fully in frame, no cropping. Only allow inscription glyphs explicitly specified in subject. Do not invent sacred symbols, cultural ornament, claims or text. No extra humans/hands/landscape/pedestals. Subject list in strict row-major order:
1. Cell row 1, column 1: An upright golden wheat sheaf with complete grain heads, branching stalks and splayed straw feet; a coral-red tied ribbon with a narrow blue band gathers the waist. Keep the natural straw structure, without added icons or lettering.
2. Cell row 1, column 2: A green long-tipped heart-shaped tree leaf and brown twig above a terracotta-colored open pitcher with a round handle and a distinct spout; pale blue water pours from the spout toward dark soil. Keep clear water and the leaf silhouette, without flowers or extra offerings.
3. Cell row 1, column 3: A warm tan wooden doorway with a muted teal opening; a closed blue-green rounded rectangular case with brass-colored end bands is mounted diagonally on the right post. Retain only the existing small shin mark on the case; no open scroll or invented scripture.
4. Cell row 2, column 1: Two separated brown hard-shell coconut halves on a low gray stone tray, their thick white flesh and hollow pale interiors facing upward. Keep the natural shell texture and split state, without a whole coconut, fibrous husk or extra offerings.
5. Cell row 2, column 2: A large dark sage-green pot and a smaller teal bowl filled with cream rice porridge and a few green herb flecks, with a brown wooden spoon raised diagonally beside them. Keep the simple prepared food and distinct pot, bowl and spoon shapes.
6. Cell row 2, column 3: A plain teal square cloth with a pale stitched edge lies across the outer sill of a gray surround and brown cross-barred window with dark blue panes. Preserve the soft doubled fabric and unpatterned surface, without symbols or extra decoration.
7. Cell row 3, column 1: One honey-brown carved wooden duck with an upturned head and long flat beak stands atop a tall narrow brown wooden pole on a low tan base. Preserve the duck's compact body, single dark eye and subtle carved wing line; no extra birds or emblems.
8. Cell row 3, column 2: Three green bamboo stems with diagonal cut tops at different heights rise from a tan straw-bound tapered base, flanked by dark green pine sprigs. Keep the center stem tallest and the two dark binding bands; no flowers, tags or extra offerings.
9. Cell row 3, column 3: A matched pair of small cream and ochre ceramic bulls stands side by side above a terracotta gabled roof ridge. Keep two separate upright horned bulls with short legs and dark eyes; no added cross, lettering or extra rooftop objects.
